    def status(self):
        return f'{self.name}: {self.hp} HP'

class Held:
    def __init__(self, name, hp):
        self.name = name
        self.hp   = hp

    def schaden(self, wert):
        self.hp -= wert

b = a
b.schaden(30)
print(a.hp)
